name: Correct the Mistake grants two stacks of Endless Sands (#3666)
contract: Bronze Timeways 807309's tooltip is "Casting Correct the Mistake now grants 2 stacks of Endless Sands". Both of its effects are aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) on the same buff 806728 (Endless Sands, StackAmount 5, 15 sec), which is how two stacks are produced - one per effect. Spell.dbc gives 807309 ProcFlags 0x0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: no stack was ever granted. Correct the Mistake 572360 is SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word1 2048, DmgClass 1, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL. The caster's health is lowered first so the heal has real healing to do. Asserting exactly two stacks, not one or more, is what proves both proc effects fired (DisableEffectsMask 0 in the row).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Endless Sands before any cast
Correct the Mistake's heal grants exactly two stacks of Endless Sands
